name: Saint Lucia
snapshot: A volcanic island of the Pitons, governed by Philip J. Pierre's Labour Party, re-elected in December 2025.
culture: Saint Lucia has produced two Nobel laureates, the economist Arthur Lewis and the poet Derek Walcott, more per head than any other country. Kwéyòl, a French-based creole, is widely spoken alongside English, reflecting the island's 14 changes of hands between France and Britain. Friday night street parties in Gros Islet are a weekly ritual.
society: Tourism dominates, with the twin Pitons volcanic spires as the island's emblem. Bananas were once the main export. Violent crime has risen, worrying an economy dependent on visitors.
situation: Philip J. Pierre's Saint Lucia Labour Party won a second term in the December 2025 election.
power: A parliamentary democracy and Commonwealth realm. The prime minister leads the majority in the 17-seat House of Assembly.

leaders.state: King Charles III, represented by a governor-general
leaders.gov: Prime Minister Philip J. Pierre, since 2021
